nodes.title: 5. LTX target profile (source-video compatibility)
Workflow Overview
widgets_values:
Workflow purpose

Character motion transfer using DiffusionGemma + LTX 2.3.

1. Reference image defines the replacement character identity and appearance.
2. Source video defines pose, action, timing, camera choreography, blocking, depth, composition, and scene geometry.
3. DiffusionGemma writes the LTX prompt from both inputs using image_identity_video_control.
4. LTX 2.3 IC-LoRA generates the transferred-motion video.

Packaged source assets live in examples/assets/character_motion_transfer.
Before running, copy that folder to ComfyUI/input/character_motion_transfer, or upload the files through ComfyUI.

Workflow inputs after copy:
- character_motion_transfer/character_reference.png
- character_motion_transfer/motion_control_video.mp4

Demo output included in the repo:
- examples/assets/character_motion_transfer/diffusiongemma_ltx_character_demo.mp4

nodes.title: Known Dependencies
widgets_values:
Known custom-node dependencies

Install missing packs through ComfyUI Manager when possible. ComfyUI-DiffusionGemmaPromptBuilder lives at https://github.com/exportAnything/ComfyUI-DiffusionGemmaPromptBuilder. A Comfy Registry release can follow once the publisher id is confirmed.

- ComfyUI-DiffusionGemmaPromptBuilder: DiffusionGemma Model Loader, Context Hub, Target Profile, CoT Generator, JSON Splitter.
- ComfyUI-LTXVideo: LTX IC-LoRA loaders and LTX guide/conditioning nodes.
- comfyui-videohelpersuite: VHS_VideoCombine output video nodes.
- comfyui-kjnodes: VAELoaderKJ, LTX2_NAG, LTXVChunkFeedForward, torch/SageAttention patch helpers.
- comfyui_controlnet_aux: DWPose, Canny, and Depth Anything preprocessors used inside the core subgraph.
- comfyui_essentials: SimpleMath+ utility node.
- comfyui-easy-use: easy cleanGpuUsed and showAnything helpers.
- RES4LYF: SeedGenerator.

Core ComfyUI supplies several LTX nodes in this workflow, including LoadVideo, LTXVPreprocess, LTXVConditioning, samplers, latent/audio/video split/concat, and the LTX latent upscaler loader.

nodes.title: Run Notes
widgets_values:
Run notes

- Use media you own or have permission to transform, especially when people are visible.
- Keep image_identity_video_control on the Context Hub for this workflow.
- Canny, Depth, and DWPose can each be connected as the control image branch. Canny is the most literal; Depth and DWPose usually leave more identity flexibility.
- DiffusionGemma is not the video sampler here. It writes the prompt/metadata contract that drives LTX.
- Check Positive Prompt and Negative Prompt previews before queueing the LTX pass.
- The workflow was tuned for 16:9, 10 seconds, 24 fps, and the 960x544-ish LTX 2.3 bucket family.

nodes.title: README
widgets_values: Connect Canny, Depth, or DWPose to Resize Image/Mask as needed. Canny preserves outlines most strongly; Depth and DWPose are often more forgiving for reference-image identity transfer.
